title: Sword of Protection
body:
I ask of Allah the Almighty to give me shelter from evil and devils. Only He can shelter us. If He protects, you
will be protected. No-one can protect themselves from devils and evil, you must ask Him to protect you. You
must know what you are doing and you must do what you understand. Allah the Almighty has given you a
sword of protection: Bismillahi rahmani rahim. With that you call to Allah and He will grant you a sword with
which you can defend yourself.
01.01.1997
